audit.proof_assessment: Prior HIGH/MEDIUM findings are closed in the revised design text: unavailable T01 roles/OwnerAssignment/separations are pinned to NOT_AVAILABLE/false with same-human assignment rejected; 15 packet artifacts plus baseCommit are stored with independent rehash; P180-R014..016 are EXCEPT_T01_SOLO/NOT_SATISFIED with waived clauses; the stored record includes paths/effects/hashes/algorithms/invalidators/self-hash; receipts are exact paths/schemas with PASS-WITH-ACCEPTED-RISK and only OBX-P180-T01-SOLO-SEPARATION-001 MEDIUM ACCEPTED; ATF/global/manifest/governance are byte/key-constrained; six-path equality forbids prefixes/globs; 18 negatives are specified against committed-byte copies; only the exact amendment tuple can authorize T01; runtime/provider/persistence/UI/Page-IR/deployment/release authority is forbidden. Live proof still shows schema v1, ATF-only, globalImplementationAuthorized false, packet CLOSED/NOT AUTHORIZED, and non-waivable governance; that is the required pre-activation state, not evidence the future record already exists. Digests/timestamps remain unspecified literals because the design requires execution-time derivation and placeholder rejection.
residual_risks: R015/R016 waived-clause cells mix waived and retained rules in prose, so a string-only oracle may not distinguish them without the other hard-coded checks.
Frozen risk-exceptions README will still say the directory has no active exception after the amendment file exists; that staleness is required by the freeze but can confuse operators.
Numbered negative tests do not separately name a now>expiresAt case distinct from 1,209,600-second interval drift, though the verifier prose rejects expired active records.
Gate 7 generates Grok and Fable together while Fable targetPaths include the Grok receipt, so implementation must freeze Grok before Fable.
Correctness of ATF/governance/dependency/packet digests is not proven by this markdown-only change and depends on the required execution-time rehash.
